issues.description: README names Clean – Global Sample, Clean – AB Share Private Meeting and Clean – AB Share Discount stages, but the package has no executable sources under those names and no sample_gdelt_qtr1/sample_qa/sample_iv/private-meeting/sample_supply panels. Table 10.do is a supplied producer for sample_abshare.dta at line 415; its sample_20240217 and auxiliary inputs remain unresolved, so it is credited as partial source code rather than called absent.
callPart.ipynb passes a quoted expression containing path_dropbox plus the relative output name, so Python treats the root as literal text. The SAS participant stage consumes this DTA handoff.
Table 1 creates ncall11 from eventId but later retains ncall1. The missing sample_gdelt_qtr1 producer prevents confirming whether ncall1 is already in the input; do not rename it without that schema.

The supplied gdelt.sas quarterly construction and Figure OA4 consumer use the same actor-country/year/quarter fields and tension measure. The producer name gdelt_qtr differs from the consumer handoff name gdelt_qtr0216.dta; align the output name and SAS-to-Stata format in a working copy, then validate ordinary fields and period. The supplied consumer does not define a distinct OA4 population or tension construction.
un_vote.sas constructs vote_dif_final but the visible export is vote_crimea; Table 4 consumes vote_dif inside sample_iv.dta. The package does not establish the durable vote_dif/sample_iv handoff.

Table 10 saves the imported CSMAR workbook as csmar_company_file.dta and then merges csmar_company_file_cn; Table OA10 instead merges csmar_company_file. Confirm the intended file and schema before changing the merge name or supplying a distinct _cn producer.
match_abfile.do merges a separate ab_list on code_b. The packaged China identifier probe reports native field stkcd, and no supplied source maps that product or key to ab_list/code_b.

cfm.py reads embassy_eng0311.pkl and text874.txt without a visible producer for either in the package. The earlier embassy pickle inputs are also not packaged; no complete press-briefing source-to-output route is established.

twitter.py calculates tweet sentiment but its visible CSV writer is inside a triple-quoted block. The only WSJ code is an .ipynb_checkpoints file with its writer also commented; Table 10's sentiment fields therefore lack an established active handoff in the supplied preparation sources.

match_abfile.do sets its data root to a hardcoded Windows D: path. This Linux workspace has no matching configured path in the package, so the working-copy root must be set before its relative reads/writes.
The existing Stata probe reports winsor2 and outreg2 not found in checked adopaths; analysis sources call them. Other user-written commands used by the workflow were not all checked.
